hooks.command: echo '{"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "UserPromptSubmit", "additionalContext": "GitHub Projects Workflow: Before implementation — Issue + board item required. Set Status In Progress when work starts. Use gh CLI (primary). Absolute blob URLs only after push+verify. Update Issue body checklist each phase."}}'

hooks.prompt:
Before stopping, verify:
1. Issue + project board item exist for non-trivial work.
2. Board Status matches reality (In Progress / Blocked / In review / Done).
3. Progress documented: body checklist updated; any .md linked via absolute URL after push+verify.
4. If project policy requires skeptic and task is complete — skeptic done.
If any required item is NO, finish it before stopping.
EXEMPT — do not block: advisory/Q&A answers even when they contain commands, paths, URLs, or shortcut tables for the user to run themselves; one-off local fetches/copies that change no repo state; usage notes posted as comments on the governing issue; work in repos whose own AGENTS.md or rules files declare opt-out from GitHub Projects tracking (e.g. 'Без GitHub Projects', 'no GitHub Projects', 'exempt from GitHub Projects tracking') — the declaration itself is the marker, do not create Issues or board items there. Judge by whether repo/config/code changed, not by message content.
